attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Nurse Registration and Nursing Education (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Nursing-practice courses presented or approved by ANCC or its local chapter, other recognized professional nursing organizations, a board-approved school/department of nursing, or other bodies approved by the Board
rules.audit_note: Licensee signs a CE attestation at renewal; keep documentation at least 4 years; subject to random audit.
rules.notes: Licenses expire March 1 every other year (odd/even assignment by license number); renewal application due before Feb 15. Hardship: one 6-month extension possible. The RIDOH nurse page (blocked to automated reading) was not checked for any topic requirement.
